settings.heading: ISO 27001 Certified Strengthening Safety and Security

settings.text:
At Andatech, safety has always been our priority. From workplace solutions to health and security tools. We’re now proud to be ISO 27001 certified, a global standard that recognises our commitment to protecting sensitive data with the same dedication
we apply to workplace safety. Together, we’re building safer, healthier, and more
secure communities.
